verdict.rationale: Data-use and training opt-out controls are a fair question for an AI coding tool, but the evidence pack never mentions a training opt-out, a privacy policy, or data-retention settings. Support for local models via Ollama is a related way to keep code from third-party providers, not a documented opt-out of model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
